blocks.tamil_translation: deeds the other Arab tribes considered good, Allah Ta'ala had placed hatred of them in your hearts even in the time of ignorance (Jahiliyyah). The others would marry two sisters at the same time. They would even marry their father's wife. They would fight in the honoured sacred months. (But you did not do these evil deeds even in the time of ignorance.) Therefore, listen to the words of this Messenger, sent from Allah Ta'ala, who belongs to the tribe of Bani Lu'ayy ibn Ghalib; through that you will attain the honour of this world and the dignity of the Hereafter. Hasten to accept him. You will receive from Allah Ta'ala the distinction (of being among the first to accept Islam),” he said. Except for one man, all the others accepted his call and became Muslims.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The sacred months are four. In them the Arabs would not fight. They are “Muharram, Rajab, Dhul-Qa'dah and Dhul-Hijjah.”
(Tafsir Ibn Kathir)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ كَانَ لَا يَقْدُمُ مِنْ سَفَرٍ إِلَّا نَهَارًا فِي الضُّحَي، فَِاذَا قَدِمَ، بَدَأَ بِالْمَسْجِدِ، فَصَلَّي فِيهِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ جَلَسَ فِيهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب استحباب ركعتين في المسجد...،رقم:١٦٥٩
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ka'b ibn Malik (RA) narrates, “It was the habit of Rasulullah ﷺ to return from a journey at the time of Duha (in the forenoon); on arriving, he would first go to the masjid, pray two rak'ahs, and then sit in the masjid.”
